steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8085/ in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with username admin and password exactly the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type that text character-for-character into the password field, do not substitute anything else. After signing in, find the project named Bench Board and open its board (the kanban view). Then report the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order, exactly as shown on the board page.

02-open: On the Bench Board project board (already open at /?controller=BoardViewController&action=show&project_id=1), create a new task with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Task' and a description that includes the text {{runid}} (for example 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Use the 'Add a new task' control on the board or the New Task form — fill the Title and Description fields, leave other fields at their defaults, and submit. Then verify the task appears on the board and report: the task's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (Kanboard shows it as #<number> on the card), the task title, and the column it landed in. Do not modify or move any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'.

03-change: On the Bench Board kanban board, move the task card titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task {{02-open.task_id_as_shown}}) from the {{01-open.columns_left_to_right_1}} column into the '{{01-open.columns_left_to_right_3}}' column. The board supports dragging cards between columns; alternatively you can use the card's dropdown menu or the task page's move/change-column action — use whatever works. Do not touch any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. After the move, verify on the board that the card {{02-open.task_id_as_shown}} '{{runid}} Bench Task' now sits in the '{{01-open.columns_left_to_right_3}}' column, and report which column it is in and the task counts per column.

04-open: Open the task page for task {{02-open.task_id_as_shown}} titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Bench Board project (URL /?controller=TaskViewController&action=show&task_id=4&project_id=1). On that task page, add a comment whose text includes the runid {{runid}} (for example 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Use the comment box / Add a comment form on the task page and submit it. Then verify the comment appears in the task page's comments section and report the exact comment text shown and the author.

05-set: On the task page for task {{02-open.task_id_as_shown}} '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Bench Board project (URL /?controller=TaskViewController&action=show&task_id=4&project_id=1), set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (December 31, 2026). Use the task page's edit/details form or the due-date control (e.g. an 'Edit' or due date field in the task details sidebar) — the app may show a date picker or accept a date in a format like 2026-12-31 or 12/31/2026. Save the change. Then verify the task page shows the due date as 2026-12-31 (or the app's displayed equivalent, e.g. 12/31/2026) and report exactly what the task page displays for the due date. Do not change any other task fields.

06-change: Final verification, read-only — do not change anything. Open the task page for task {{02-open.task_id_as_shown}} '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Bench Board project (URL /?controller=TaskViewController&action=show&task_id=4&project_id=1) and report from the page: (1) the task's numeric ID exactly as displayed (the #number shown), (2) the task title, (3) the task description text, (4) the column the task is in, (5) the text of any comments on the task, (6) the due date shown. Then go back to the Bench Board board and report the column names left-to-right and which column contains the card {{02-open.task_id_as_shown}} '{{runid}} Bench Task'.
